description_en: Queries the real-time network status of a mobile phone number, such as normal, suspended, or non-existent. Supports querying numbers in plaintext or encrypted with MD5 or SHA-256
description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询
name: PhoneNumberStatusForPublic

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page of the Phone Number Dictionary console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit mobile phone number.
If Mask is set to MD5, this field is a 32-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SHA256, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.
If Mask is set to SM3, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.

Letters in the encrypted string are case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SM3，该字段为64位加密字符串。

加密字符串中字母不区分大小写
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

NORMAL: No encryption.

MD5

SHA256

SM3
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密

MD5

SHA256

SM3
parameters.name: mask

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: Successful.
OperatorLimit: The mobile phone number is prohibited from being queried by the carrier.
RequestFrequencyLimit: Due to carrier restrictions, high-frequency repeated queries for the same number within a short period are prohibited. If this error code is returned, try again later.

For more error codes, visit the Error Code Center (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/Dytnsapi/2020-02-17/errorCode)
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：成功。
OperatorLimit：运营商禁止查询的手机号。
RequestFrequencyLimit：因运营商限制，禁止在短时间内高频对同一个号码进行反复查询，如返回此错误码，请您稍后再试。

请访问错误码中心 (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/Dytnsapi/2020-02-17/errorCode)查看更多错误码

Carrier.description_en:
The base carrier to which the number currently belongs. If the queried number has undergone mobile number portability, the base carrier after the portability is returned.

Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile.
CUCC: China Unicom.
CTCC: China Telecom.
CBN: China Broadnet
Carrier.description_zh:
号码当前归属的基础运营商。如果查询的号码存在携号转网，则返回携号转网后的基础运营商。

取值：

CMCC：中国移动。
CUCC：中国联通。
CTCC：中国电信。
CBN：中国广电

Status.description_en:
The returned status of the queried mobile phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: Normal.
SHUTDOWN: Suspended.
POWER_OFF: Powered off.
NOT_EXIST: Non-existent.
SUSPECTED_POWER_OFF : Suspected to be powered off.
BUSY: Busy.
UNKNOWN: Unknown.

Due to carrier system adjustments, China Telecom numbers do not support the following returned statuses: Busy, Suspected to be powered off, and Powered off. For more information, see the announcement on the official website (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2489709.html)
Status.description_zh:
检测手机号返回状态。取值：

NORMAL：正常。
SHUTDOWN：停机。
POWER_OFF：关机。
NOT_EXIST：空号。
SUSPECTED_POWER_OFF ：疑似关机。
BUSY：忙。
UNKNOWN：未知。

因运营商系统调整，中国电信的号码不支持返回：忙、疑似关机、关机状态。 详见官网公告 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2489709.html)

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. The ID of each request is unique and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
